representation: Pending variant in existing PhysicalSectorRole; final ordered role-only scan; no cursor field or marker allocation
reason: A monotonic cursor still traverses the physical-role prefix in aggregate, while adding state and branches to individual claims. The selected role-only scan removes repeated final FAT lookups without that cursor state. Added decoding and claim work is not assumed free and remains within mandatory whole-XLS-owner instruction and native gates.
prior_design: 0554 bitset/cursor was a proof hypothesis. This prospective representation uses the same exact pending-marker invariant in already allocated role storage, with an ordered final scan instead of a separate bitset or cursor.
